items.title: uv-build includes .mypy_cache in subdirectories by default
items.reason: Closest symptom and policy discussion: uv_build includes an untracked cache directory inside the module tree, the reporter proposed respecting Git ignores, and a maintainer confirmed that VCS-independent selection is intentional.

items.title: Option to include vcs tracked files in source distribution with uv build backend
items.reason: Closest capability discussion: it proposes opt-in VCS-aware source selection, but would broaden the sdist to all tracked repository files rather than filter ignored package-tree files or warn about them.

items.title: Build backend tracking issue
items.reason: The original uv_build design review compares other backends’ VCS-ignore behavior and documents the inclusion/exclusion design context.

related.search_scope: Searched open and closed issues plus open, closed, and merged pull requests for `.gitignore`, `git-ignored`, `VCS ignore`, `ignore-vcs`, tracked files, ignored files, hidden or sensitive files, `.mypy_cache`, `source-exclude`, and `wheel-exclude`. Conceptual searches covered VCS-aware selection, accidental publication, default exclusions, and Hatchling/Poetry behavior. No pull request implements VCS-aware uv_build selection; astral-sh/uv#9525 and astral-sh/uv#9013 establish the current explicit-glob model. astral-sh/uv#12970 and astral-sh/uv#10556 were ruled out because both incidents used Hatchling rather than uv_build.

type_reason: uv_build’s documented implementation deliberately selects the module tree independently of VCS state, using three default exclusions plus configured source and wheel exclusions. An opt-in VCS filter or warning would add functionality. The nearest issues differ materially in their default-versus-opt-in behavior, selection scope, or warning semantics, so this is not a duplicate.
summary: This is an enhancement to intentional uv_build behavior. astral-sh/uv#19403 is the closest symptom and policy discussion, astral-sh/uv#16075 is the closest opt-in VCS-selection proposal, and astral-sh/uv#8779 provides the original design comparison.
draft_response: Thanks for raising this. uv_build currently selects files independently of Git state by design: it includes the configured module tree, applies the built-in `__pycache__`, `*.pyc`, and `*.pyo` exclusions, and then applies `source-exclude` and `wheel-exclude`. We discussed the same risk from untracked files in astral-sh/uv#19403; the VCS-independent model avoids checkout-dependent builds and allows ignored generated data to be packaged. astral-sh/uv#16075 is related, but proposes including all VCS-tracked files in the sdist rather than filtering ignored files from normal package selection. An opt-in filter or warning would be a new build-backend feature. For now, `source-exclude` and `wheel-exclude` are the available controls; evaluating this proposal would require clear semantics for builds outside a VCS checkout and for explicitly included or generated ignored files.
